description: Check a PDF on this computer (input_path) or at a public URL against the machine-checkable criteria of PDF/UA (up to 25 MB and 500 pages). Returns how many criteria are met, the topics with problems, their pages and steps to fix them in Word, InDesign and Acrobat, and links to the full report. With id, get the result of an earlier check that was still running. The result is never a statement that the file meets legal requirements; a manual review is always needed.

input_path.description: Path of the PDF on this computer. Use this, url or id.

profile.description: PDF/UA part. auto (default) picks it from the file.

report_pdf.description: Also create the report as an accessible PDF (English). Default false.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, in seconds (default 600). If the conversion is still running then, the answer contains the conversion id for get_conversion.

url.description: Public http or https URL of the PDF.

name: check_pdf_accessibility
title: Check PDF accessibility
